title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Learning from the last game
hook: Do you talk about last weekend's game at practice?
intro: Monday practice starts with a long talk.
statement: One lesson from a game is worth more than a full review.
q1: Do you pick one thing from the game to practice —
q2: or leave the game behind and start fresh?
q3: What did the game show you to work on?
t1: Both can work. But practice feels lighter
t2: when the review is short and points forward.
cta: Coaches — do you review games at practice?
ctaLines: One lesson. One drill. Move on.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you talk about last weekend's game at practice?
The team lost on Saturday. Monday practice starts with a long talk.
One lesson from a game is worth more than a full review.
One lesson from the game or a fresh start. There is no perfect answer.
Do you review games at practice? Share your habit in the comments.
